items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: That's right, Thad Jones did it. It was released with Thad Jones.

ctx.x: Yeah, 'Portrait' is what I wrote. It was never released. That's right, Thad Jones did it. It was released with Thad Jones. Three or four vocalists were a guy who won [MOUTH] a whore, Celia, an Arthur Godfrey Award. Max's wife, (inaudible), she wanted this kid to produce (inaudible) it was going to be a big hit. So they did a show called Fanny. I think it was Fanny. Yeah, was there a show called 'Fanny?'
Yeah, there was a Broadway show called 'Fanny.'
